description_en: Transforms a pay-as-you-go Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance into a subscription instance
description_zh: 将按量付费的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例转换为包年包月（预付费）实例
name: TransformToPrePaid

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh: 预付费时长，单位为月。取值：1~9、12、24、36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:
true: enables automatic payment.
false: disables automatic payment (default). You must manually renew the instance in the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付款，取值：
true：自动付款。
false：手动付款（默认），您通过控制台对实例进行手动续费，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

This parameter is required when AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。

当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

EndTime.description_en:
The time when the instance expires after the billing method of the instance is changed to subscription.

The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
实例付费方式转换为包年包月后的实例到期时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间
